from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import replace
import hashlib
import json
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "src"))
import cv2
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.artifact_proposal import OpenCvArtifactProposalService
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.artifact_reference import decode_reference, OpenCvArtifactReferenceReviewer
from oil_tracker.adapters.storage.json_recipe_repository import JsonRecipeRepository
from oil_tracker.domain.recipe import InspectionRecipe
from oil_tracker.ui.widgets.roi_editor_dialog import RoiEditorDialog
from oil_tracker.ui.widgets.artifact_support_dialog import ArtifactSupportDialog

out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
saved = root / "sample/output/s11-d2-recipe-artifact-20261008-001/setup-f1320"
inputs = [saved / "proposals.json", saved / "f1320-full.png"]
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pins = {str(p.relative_to(root)): sha(p) for p in inputs}
prior = json.loads(inputs[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
recipe = InspectionRecipe.from_dict(prior["recipe"])
glass = recipe.glasses[0]
frame = cv2.imread(str(inputs[1]))
app = QApplication([])
editor = RoiEditorDialog(frame, glass, frame.shape[1], frame.shape[0],
    artifact_proposer=OpenCvArtifactProposalService(), source_frame_index=1320, source_time_sec=44.,
    reference_reviewer=OpenCvArtifactReferenceReviewer())
editor.show()
app.processEvents()
editor.scan_artifacts_button.click()
proposals = editor._artifact_proposals
assert len(proposals) == len(prior["proposals"]) == 12
references = []
for template, old in zip(proposals, prior["proposals"], strict=True):
    geometry = template.to_dict(include_reference=False)
    geometry.pop("id")
    expected = dict(old["template"])
    expected.pop("id")
    assert geometry == expected
    snapshot, images = decode_reference(template.support_reference)
    assert snapshot["frame_index"] == 1320 and snapshot["time_sec"] == 44
    x, y = snapshot["crop_origin"]
    w, h = snapshot["crop_size"]
    assert (images["original_roi"] == frame[y:y+h, x:x+w]).all()
    references.append({"candidate_input_index": snapshot["proposal"]["candidate_input_index"],
        "source": snapshot["proposal"]["source"], "y": snapshot["proposal"]["y"],
        "crop_origin": [x, y], "crop_size": [w, h], "bytes": len(template.support_reference.snapshot_json.encode()),
        "sha256": template.support_reference.snapshot_sha256,
        "native_available": snapshot["proposal"]["native_path"] is not None})
editor.artifact_proposal_list.setCurrentRow(5)
editor.grab().save(str(out / "proposal-editor.png"))
template = proposals[5]
assert template.support_reference.snapshot()["proposal"]["y"] == 822
review = ArtifactSupportDialog(template, glass, frame.shape[1], frame.shape[0], reference_reviewer=OpenCvArtifactReferenceReviewer())
review.show()
app.processEvents()
review.grab().save(str(out / "support-original.png"))
# UI demonstration only. No human edge attribution, no existing label mutation.
review.canvas.set_review_rect((20, 18, 35, 12))
assert not review.confirm_edges.isChecked()
review.grab().save(str(out / "support-scope.png"))
review.mode.setCurrentIndex(review.mode.findData("canny"))
review.grab().save(str(out / "support-canny.png"))
review.accept()
assert review.reviewed_reference().review_state == "mixed_or_uncertain"
editor._artifact_proposals[5] = replace(template, support_reference=review.reviewed_reference())
editor.accept_artifact_button.click()
recipe.glasses[0] = editor.edited_glass()
path = out / "ui-demo-only.oilrecipe"
repository = JsonRecipeRepository()
repository.save(path, recipe)
assert repository.load(path).to_dict() == recipe.to_dict()
assert all(sha(root / name) == digest for name, digest in pins.items())
result = {"inputs": pins, "runner_sha256": sha(Path(__file__)), "proposal_geometry_equal": 12,
          "references": references, "input_preserved": True, "video_read": False,
          "new_physical_review": False, "demo_review_state": "mixed_or_uncertain",
          "recipe_bytes": path.stat().st_size, "screenshots": {p.name: sha(p) for p in out.glob("*.png")}}
(out / "readout.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"proposal_geometry_equal": 12, "references": len(references), "recipe_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                  "max_reference_bytes": max(row["bytes"] for row in references), "input_preserved": True}))
review.close()
editor.close()
app.processEvents()
